verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Dynadot offers DNS record management via API/MCP and dashboard ('adjust DNS settings', 'review nameservers and DNS records'), but nothing specifies which record types are supported, TTL granularity, or UI usability. Missing for 10: documentation of supported record types (A/AAAA/MX/TXT/CNAME/SRV/etc.), TTL configuration limits, and any hands-on account of the DNS management UI experience.
